description:
Landed in:
- DevHub-Plugins `9ee7d3f`: B7: Board.Scrum — sprint rules in Board.Core (create, edit with dates and capacity, start with a record of what was committed, complete with what was finished and unfinished issues moved to the backlog / a planned sprint / a new one, delete future sprints, reorder, PlanIssue = sprint + rank; one sprint runs at a time; 8 tests) and the Board.Scrum plugin (requires Board): sprint planning replaces the Backlog on Scrum boards (a list per open sprint with dates, goal, points against capacity, Start / Complete / Edit / Delete / Up / Down; drag issues between sprints and the backlog), Start / Edit / Complete Sprint dialogs, Create Sprint and Sprint Planning actions. Board: pages replaced per board kind (and rebuilt when a board switches between Scrum and Kanban), header buttons for lists and planning pages, rows open the issue panel on a tap (a drag never taps, so the lists don't move under it), flat section headers. Checked in a running DevHub: create a sprint, drag an issue into it, start it, the Scrum board shows it
